field_evidence: Official Planning Data listed-building-outline entity 42175360 provides an authoritative closed nonzero-area MultiPolygon for Southport Library on Lord Street, Sefton, reference 158, entry-date 2025-08-20. Its direct listed-building key 1379675 matches Historic England NHLE 1379675, Grade II, first listed 29-Jul-1999, with statutory addresses Southport Library Lord Street and 1-9 Eastbank Street. The statutory description confirms the building was originally a bank built in 1879, later integrated with the adjoining Atkinson Library and Art Gallery as part of Southport Library. BUILDING_PRESENT and library use are evidenced historically; no claim of current operation or parcel materialization.
